_doc: Composition gates a sub-tile may name with spec "benched_by" (tools/ref_tile/README.md, 'Behavioural bench at submit'). The loop reads THIS file from main (the daemon tree), never from the job's branch, and appends each gate's benches to the job as <gate>_<name>; they run in the job's own source snapshot, so the composition is built from the sub-tile's RTL at its source commit. Every gate needs >= 1 behavioural expect=pass bench and >= 1 expect=fail mutant.

s81_vm_fe_h_lockstep.what: S81 VM front end hierarchy dsfd_vm_fe_h (16 clt, 4 fxs, fxr relay tiles, 10 flt, fld, fcc, fcw, fcn, frg / fra / frr, 4 fsr; parent = wires) as a shadow of the flat dsfd_vm_fe at the hierarchy's stage counts: every FE output bit-exact every cycle on gold_s1 (LOCKSTEP_OK, mismatches 0); mutant: one fxr stage fewer on port 16 of slice 2 must break lockstep (LOCKSTEP_BAD). For the FE leaf masters, which have no golden of their own. Mechanics only: production throughput is the ROM per-layer gate.

vm8_cp.what: HBM VM8 channel-plan control plane, all 25 tiles composed (hfd_vm_cp) against the monolithic hfd_vm: transaction hashes seeds 1-3, every output bit at one constant latency, one-depth root ports; mutants XBUS (SE slice write-data bits) and RELAY (xSE tap bits in the E fork) must fail. Mechanics only: production throughput is a separate gate.

smn_native_sm.what: HBM native SM composition, production shape (NC 8, 8 active columns, RMAX 4096, request credit, hierarchical gated tiles): the 13-op stress sequence bit-exact against the golden with the clock-gating lockstep at 0 mismatches; mutants must fail: front s1 line register inverted (golden mismatch, no timeout), tile wake 32 edges late and no drain hold (lockstep mismatches). For SM sub-tiles with no golden of their own (native front_n / front_s / fcxr / back ends). The tile clusters carry the regional-strap mutant in their own job.benches

benches.cmd: export PATH=/home/ubuntu/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin:$PATH; W=$(mktemp -d /tmp/smng.XXXXXX); python3 tools/dshbm_sm_pq_seq.py run --seq stress --nc 8 --active 8 --rmax 4096 --req-credit --smh --cg --define OT_SMH_CG_ENREG --define OT_SMH_XLK --define OT_FP_DATA_NORST --define OT_SMH_DRST0 --define OT_SMH_RSTRELAY --define OT_SMH_HIER --define OT_SMH_PTW_OHDLY --define OT_SMH_PRODUCTION_SHAPE --cg-gap 300 --build-jobs 8 --workdir $W --out {RUN}/cg_exact.json > {RUN}/cg_exact.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -5 {RUN}/cg_exact.log; grep -h CG_LOCKSTEP $W/*/runtime.log; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -q 'CG_LOCKSTEP mismatches 0 ' $W/*/runtime.log && python3 -c 'import json,sys; x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert x["nc"] == 8 and x["active_columns"] == 8 and x["rmax"] == 4096 and x["timeout"] is None and x["status"] == "pass" and x["mismatching_ops"] == 0; print("SMN_EXACT_PASS", x["mismatching_ops"])' {RUN}/cg_exact.json

quant_wide.what: HBM FUSED.QDQ wide engine, hierarchical WQ 2 with the 3-tile decoder (ot_hgi_quant_wide_h in ot_hgi_quant_unit): the eight DS-V4.1 per-die records, all 3,328 output words exact against the released golden (tb_hgi_quant_wide_tput), w3 forced packet path exact as the control; mutants must fail in simulation: m1 (header A-operand bit) and w1 (lane-to-sector map). Vectors committed in tools/hgi_unit_tput/vectors/qdqvec; the job's source commit must hold them and tools/hgi_unit_tput/run_qdq_wide_gate.sh (merge main).

Needs the WQ 3 runner and bench of codex/el1012-hbm-fq-cx in the job's source commit.

qfd_vm_region_prod.what: Qwen TP8 VM region built from its closed leaves (ot_qfd_vm_region_leaf: 8 x bctl_t, 6 x sctl_t, 2 x rr4_t (kept AND-OR tree), rr2_t, 8 x bank_t, 6 x su_t, 16 x xfifo8_t, 3 x su1024_t, delay leaves bound to the routed ot_qwen_tree_delay1_t / delay2_t) against the flat ot_qfd_vm_region_quarter at the ROUTED parameters (DEPTH 174 / LAW 8 / DEPTHS 695 / LAWS 10, NPP 12, MEREG 1), xo / ro / so / ovf on every clock; mutants in rr4_t, bctl_t, sctl_t, rr2_t, at bank_t's and su_t's write-data pins and in su1024_t must fail (VM4 2026-10-13: gctl_t / rowrd_t are dissolved into the per-consumer leaves). Behavioural memories (USE_MACRO 0). Needs a source snapshot that holds tools/qwen_tp8/vm_leaf_gate.sh (claude/qwen-tp8-vm-verif or later). Evidence: results/rtl/qwen_tp8_vm_plane_20261013/leaf_gate/record.json.

benches.name: exact
benches.pass_regex: PASS qfd_vm_region_leaf DEPTH=174 LAW=8 DEPTHS=695 LAWS=10

qfd_vm_xplane_prod.what: Qwen TP8 VM bit-plane leaf miter at the ROUTED parameters: 32 x ot_qfd_vm_xplane_t (NRB 64) behind 10 x 64 ot_qfd_vm_xrelay_t (W 512) against the parent's flat rot1 / rot2 / bv, ELEMS 177,808, with beats that run past ELEMS; mutants in plane 5 (range count = the parent's MUT 5, which the VM system bench cannot see and only this gate kills; fine rotation) and one free-running relay must fail. Needs a source snapshot that holds tools/qwen_tp8/vm_leaf_gate.sh (claude/qwen-tp8-vm-verif or later). Evidence: results/rtl/qwen_tp8_vm_plane_20261013/leaf_gate/record.json.

s81su_tiles.what: S81 SU routed-top gate: the slab dsfd_sp_su_h rebuilt by tools/s81_suhc/su_tile_tops.py so that every engine core instance IS its routed top dsfd_su_t_<x> (chosen at elaboration by parameter equality: no match stops the run with SU_TILE_TOPS_NOMATCH; port widths checked with $bits; wrapper ties asserted), full shape, bit-exact against the golden; then one output mutant per routed-top class, every one must fail with error rows (a survivor = that tile is not observed). In the loop it runs with DPI float models (minutes, 64 GB). A tile that holds float primitives (swe, qne, qnq, qbe, kvq, kve, sm*) is qualified by the SAME gate under --fp rtl, recorded once per RTL in results/rtl/ref_tile/s81su_tiles_gate_<sha>/qualification.json (f6ff6785b: exact PASS 0/1722 x3 at 3,146 cycles, 21 of 21 class mutants fail; ~384 GB and ~2.5 h, not a loop bench): re-run it when the RTL under such a tile changes. Needs tools/s81_suhc/su_tiles_gate.sh in the job's source commit (merge main).

qfd_tt_up4_w.what: Qwen ROM TP8 slot tt_up4_0 WITHOUT a parent: 4 x ot_qfd_band_upper leaves (kit qfd_tt_up4_leaf, NL 4 / LNK 0 / DLY 1) through the wires-only wrapper qfd_tt_up4_w (per-leaf bundles, die fan-out of selects / valids / faults and the fault OR done by the bench as the die does), 3 bands of 16 lanes, selects one edge late (the control tile's output station): every tree-top word bit-exact against the golden (280,736 words, latency +5 = the flat NL 16 block: no cycle added). Mutants: two leaves' band-0 words swapped in the wrapper; leaf-internal band index. Mechanics only: production throughput is the ROM per-layer gate.

s81_be_hard_relays.what: Current source BE with HARD_RELAYS1, selected R3/KD3/CCA/XRT FE: golden64k cycles bitexact; stale transport mutant must fail; no added native throughput cycles. This binds all fixed BE relay/reset masters, with full die ownstate explicit.

s81_hrow_hard_relays.what: Full production hrow_td with HARD_RELAYS1: three protocol positives/rejections, exact row versions; no-epoch and no-part mutants must fail. Bind 12660 die relay bits plus reset synchroniser, no latency change.

s81hc_ng256_retcol.what: S81 HC slab composition, NG256 production shape, HIER 3 tail split + NORM tree + RETCOL 1 (ot_s81_hc_cth_ntc: four-column return rows, ret_column_c0..3 + ctrn_col_e/w leaves): bit-exact against the DPI golden (golden_L0_L2 + 2 stress, 1940 rows each); mutant 1 (no write-back) must fail. HC-HOMES 10-16.
